queries: select product_id, count(*) n, round(avg(is_delayed::int),2) dr, round(avg(case when order_date>='2024-03-04' then is_delayed::int end),2) dr_after, round(avg(case when order_date<'2024-03-04' then is_delayed::int end),2) dr_before from supplier_delivery where supplier_id='SUP-001' group by 1 order by 1

select date_trunc('week',date) wk, round(avg(case when product_id in (select id from product where supplier_id='SUP-001') then value end),0) s1, round(avg(case when product_id in (select id from product where supplier_id='SUP-002') then value end),0) s2 from stock_snapshot group by 1 order by 1

select date_trunc('week',order_date) wk, sum(case when supplier_id='SUP-001' then quantity end) q1, round(avg(case when supplier_id='SUP-001' then delay_days end),1) d1 from supplier_delivery group by 1 order by 1
select date_trunc('week',date) wk, count(*) n from order_cancellation group by 1 order by 1
